steps: GUI planning, build and actual Godot run select protocol 9. Two initial entries and three queued event entries remain five separate records: idle / idle / action / idle / idle. All choose the same clip and precede ten executed commands; the final repeated idle entry proves restart is not merged. Terminal state snapshots remain separate.
Read-only entry rows retain their binding filter and separate accepted state / execution cutoff in Chinese, English and Japanese at 390px, with no horizontal overflow.

Binding and script source buttons navigate through the existing editor to their frozen source locations. Building, running, filtering, language changes and navigation leave every author file unchanged.
